title: fix(service-automation): a connector's failure text carries no credential part its metadata read withholds
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:连接器实例失败时由提供方抛出的错误文字,在被平台存储、对外返回或写入日志之前,先经过连接器元数据读取所用的同一个凭据判定改写;读取不返回的凭据部分,在这些文字里同样不出现。
- 为什么改:规则是「元数据读取不返回的凭据部分,不得经由平台存储、返回或记录的任何其他文字回来」;失败文字是外来文字,可能原样带出存储的地址。
- 风险与回滚:只改文字,不改实例状态、重试、错误的 code/status/name;不含地址与凭据的文字原样不变。回滚即还原本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-read-withheld-text.ts`(唯一判定入口,复用 `getMetadataTypeRedactor('connector')`);`plugin.ts` 物化失败的 catch 块与 `withFailureTextRewritten`;`connector-credentials.ts` 的 `upstreamRefusalMessage` 先判定后去值的顺序。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/connector-read-withheld-text.test.ts`,预期 12 项全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Rule: a credential part the connector metadata read withholds never comes back in any other text the platform stores, serves or logs.

- One predicate. `connectorReadWithheldText(entry)` (new, `connector-read-withheld-text.ts`) judges nothing itself: it applies the connector redactor every metadata read exit runs (`getMetadataTypeRedactor('connector')`) to the stored entry, and to every URL-shaped run in the text, and replaces each piece with the form that read serves. A string the read withholds whole (a header or environment map value, an inline `auth` secret) reads `[credential withheld]`.
- Where it applies, once, where the text enters the platform: a provider factory's failure while an instance materializes (every reader below the catch takes the rewritten value: `degradedReason` on `GET /api/v1/automation/connectors` and `getConnectorDescriptors()`, the credential-reference listing, a `connector_action` refusal, a stored credential row's status reason, the degrade, hold and fail log records, a boot's failure); a handler's failure on a call (a flow run's step error, the pull door); an upstream's refusal words on a call.
- Order: the read's predicate judges the provider's own text first, then the resolved credential value is withheld, so the predicate sees each URL as the provider wrote it.
- A failure keeps its `code`, `status` and `name`; one that holds nothing to withhold is the thrown value itself.
- Unchanged: the route's audience, the stored row, the URL the instance uses.

## Tests

- `connector-read-withheld-text.test.ts` (12): the rewrite against the read itself (stored URL, a parser re-rendered URL, the instance's `paramName` pair, a map the read withholds whole); every reader of a materialization failure (descriptor, degraded reason, log records, boot failure); a call's failure (message rewritten, `code`/`status` kept); an upstream's refusal words. Controls: a text with no URL, and a URL with no credential part, come back unchanged; a call failure with nothing to withhold is the same thrown value.
- `connector-credential-door.test.ts`: the form-encoded spelling pin reads both predicates in one text (the read's pair removed, the value withheld under a name the read keeps).
- Door level, `connector-failure-text-withheld.dogfood.test.ts` (showcase boot, openapi provider): `GET /automation/connectors` for a member and an administrator, the credential-reference listing and the log records carry the URL as the metadata read serves it; controls: the stored row keeps its URL whole, a URL with no credential part is served as stored.

## Acceptance notes

- The audience of `degradedReason` on `GET /automation/connectors` is unchanged by this PR; who should be served it is left to the seat.
- `connector-credential-door.test.ts`: the form-encoded spelling pin now carries the value twice in one URL (under the instance's `paramName`, and under a name the read keeps), so it reads both predicates and their order.
